description: This file defines the Perl module Git::SVN::Utils, providing utility functions used across the Git::SVN project. It includes functions for URL and path canonicalization, checking for compression support, and utility functions like joining paths and adding paths to URLs. It also exports specific functions for external use.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Prints a message to standard error and exits with status 1.

methods.name: can_compress
methods.description: Checks if the Compress::Zlib module is available for use.

methods.name: canonicalize_path
methods.description: Converts a given file path into a canonical form suitable for SVN API usage.

methods.name: canonicalize_url
methods.description: Converts a URL into a canonical format suitable for SVN API usage.

methods.name: join_paths
methods.description: Joins multiple path segments into a single path, cleaning redundant slashes.

methods.name: add_path_to_url
methods.description: Appends a given path to a URL, properly handling slashes and encoding.
